titolo: NordicTrack Commercial 1750 | Treadmill for Runners - NordicTrack
ld: Perfect for beginner to intermediate runners looking to improve their endurance. Follow iFIT Trainers in on or off-treadmill workouts on a 16” pivoting touchscreen.
Built for beginner to intermediate runners. 16-inch pivoting screen, 12 MPH, folds for storage, Lifetime Motor Warranty. HSA/FSA eligible.
